name: agenteur
description: Coordinate Claude Code and Codex sessions with durable tasks, messages, leases, and notifications.

args: for r in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}" . ..; do [ -f "$r/scripts/run-codex.sh" ] && exec sh "$r/scripts/run-codex.sh"; done; echo "agenteur: scripts/run-codex.sh not found from $PWD" >&2; exit 1

interface.longDescription: Coordinate shared work through durable tasks and messages, with verified Codex app-server result delivery.
